verdict.rationale: Floot's core interaction model is natural language. Apps are built from a plain-language description, and users can say "make this a mobile app", ask the assistant to restore a checkpoint, or describe an integration and have endpoints, tables and screens built. It can also be driven from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor chats via its MCP server. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation (all evidence is vendor-claimed docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Floot turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app
Take any website you've built on Floot and say "make this a mobile app."
Ask it to restore a checkpoint from before the change went sideways.
Describe the integration you want to your AI assistant, and the endpoints, database tables, and screens get built for you.
It lets you build and ship full-stack apps without leaving your AI chat — works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more
